## PR checks (GitHub Actions)

| Workflow | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `ci.yml` (CI / Server Tests) | PRs (except `version-*-beta` branches and js/css/md/html/csv-only changes) + nightly cron | `compileall` + merge-conflict marker scan, bootstraps frappe-bench with MariaDB 11.8 (`.github/helper/install.sh`), runs `bench run-parallel-tests --app healthcare`. Non-PR runs upload coverage to Codecov. |
| `linters.yml` / `linters.v2.yml` | PR (v2 also push/dispatch) | `pre-commit` (ruff, ruff-format, prettier, eslint, pip-audit, detect-secrets, basic checks) + Semgrep with Frappe rules and `r/python.lang.correctness` |
| `semantic-commits.yml` | PR | commitlint on every commit in the PR |
| `docs_checker.yml` | PR | `feat` PRs must link docs (`.github/helper/documentation.py`) |
| `labeller.yml` | PR opened | applies `needs-tests` via `.github/labeler.yml` |
| `codeql.yml` | push/PR to develop + weekly | CodeQL for Python and JavaScript |

Mergify merges after at least one approval. Dependabot updates GitHub Actions weekly.

## Release pipeline (inherited from upstream earthians/biograph)

1. `initiate_release.yml` runs weekly (Tuesday 09:30 UTC) and opens `chore: release vNN` PRs from `version-NN-hotfix` to `version-NN` for 14, 15 and 16.
2. `on_release.yml` runs on push to `version-14/15/16` and executes **semantic-release** (`.releaserc`, angular preset; breaking changes do not trigger major releases). It rewrites the version in `healthcare/__init__.py`, commits `chore(release): Bumped to Version x.y.z`, and creates a GitHub release.
3. `release_notes.yml` regenerates release notes and strips `chore/ci/test/docs/style` lines. PRs labelled `skip-release-notes` are excluded (`.github/release.yml`).
4. `generate-pot-file.yml` runs weekly and refreshes `healthcare/locale/main.pot`. Crowdin opens `fix: sync translations from crowdin` PRs.

Several workflows hard-code `earthians/biograph` and need upstream secrets (`EARTHIANS_BOT_TOKEN`, `RELEASE_TOKEN`, `CODECOV_TOKEN`), so release automation may not work in this fork as-is. Deployment is done by installing or updating the app on a bench or Frappe Cloud (`bench get-app` / `install-app healthcare` / `migrate`). The repo contains no deploy workflow.
